summary: Iteration 4 — verified cookie+CSRF auth migration and Resources CRUD. 17/17 backend pytest cases pass and 8/8 frontend E2E steps pass. No issues found; feature is production-ready.

TestCookieAuth: /auth/me works with cookie alone (no Authorization header)
TestCsrf: Bearer auth bypasses CSRF (no cookie attack possible)
TestResourcesCRUD: Editor full CRUD: POST 201 (label/url/kind/order_index returned + embedded in roadmap), PATCH 200 (label+kind+url+order_index updated and persisted), DELETE without CSRF=403, DELETE with CSRF=204, resource removed from /roadmaps/frontend block.resources
TestExistingViaCookie: GET /api/admin/users via cookie (admin) -> 200 with all seeded emails

passed: Editor login -> /dashboard; access_token cookie HttpOnly, csrf_token cookie HttpOnly=false (only csrf visible to JS via document.cookie)
Page reload keeps user authenticated (cookie-based session, no localStorage)
RoadmapDetail editor mode: toggle-edit-mode-btn present, opens block side panel, block-editor-resources section visible with 2 seeded resources + Add button
Add resource -> new resource-row-{id} appears (3 rows); filling label+url triggers debounced auto-save (no errors)
Delete resource via confirm dialog -> row removed
Logout -> access_token + csrf_token cookies cleared, /api/auth/me returns 401

Standard user (user@example.com) on /roadmaps/frontend: no toggle-edit-mode-btn; clicking block shows side-panel-resources (read-only, links open in new tab); no resource-add-btn; no block-editor-resources section

critical_code_review_comments: Cookie security: COOKIE_KW has secure=False — fine for the http preview env; flip to True for production deploys over HTTPS. The samesite=lax + HttpOnly + double-submit-csrf combination is correct.
server.py is now ~650 lines and growing; consider splitting routers into /app/backend/routers/{auth,roadmaps,resources,progress,admin}.py for maintainability.

Bearer-bypass of CSRF (server.py:634) is intentional and documented, but make sure no future API consumer ever puts a Bearer header AND relies on cookie session simultaneously — that combo would silently skip CSRF.
ResourceRow auto-save debounce (500ms) is reasonable but there is no visible save indicator; consider adding a 'saved' check or toast for UX.

Login.jsx uses data-testid='login-email-input'/'login-password-input'/'login-submit-btn' — the review_request mentions slightly different conventions; existing tests rely on the current names so no change needed, just noting it.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates and cleans up its own TEST_ prefixed resource (created+deleted within test_editor_full_crud). One TEST_note progress record left by test_progress_upsert_via_cookie on user's first block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 4 deliverables (cookie+CSRF migration, Resources CRUD) verified end-to-end. Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_cookie_csrf_resources.py is a reusable regression suite covering auth, CSRF and resources. From iteration 3: an unrelated 'Test' roadmap (slug test-rm) still exists in DB and should probably be cleaned up.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found in this iteration.
